q.g: To do this task, grab a bolt-action rifle or an MP-18 and do not attach any scopes or sights. Use only the iron sights. Factory is not recommended for this quest as there are not many places where you can effectively engage at 40m or further. Only Scavs count towards this quest, not PMCs. Woods, Shoreline, and Customs are good maps because of the sniper Scavs that can be spotted from a far distance.
